_comment: Where package installs look for new releases. This committed copy is a placeholder so the public repo stays org-agnostic: put your real values in update-channel.local.json (gitignored, same shape) and make-release.sh injects them into the release zip, so package installs receive the real channel while the git repo never carries it. Git installs ignore this file entirely; they track their own origin remote. Full mechanics: workflows/update.md.
